method: Manual readings from frames requested every 0.1 recording seconds around the two observed changes. These show a human-operated manual shift, not an automatic paddle controller.
interpretation: First visible gear changes are near clocks 5.117 and 10.817 s. RPM falls for about 0.4 and 0.6 s from the preceding sampled high value to undershoot. Exact clutch travel, command onset, and analog pedal levels are not observable. Manual undershoot must not be mistaken for the ratio-consistent settled RPM.
